## Behavior

Describe the user-visible or contract change.

## Verification

List commands actually run and their results. Mark unrun or hardware-dependent checks as unverified.

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] Relevant browser or extension checks, when applicable
- [ ] New behavior has focused tests or a written reason why a test is not practical

## Security and privacy

Describe trust-boundary, storage, permission, online-egress, extension, model, or supply-chain impact.

- [ ] No credentials, personal data, local home paths, browser profiles, or exact host fingerprints are included
- [ ] New network access is explicit, scoped, and reflected in disclosure receipts
- [ ] New dependencies and generated artifacts have attribution and license coverage

## Limitations

List known unsupported behavior and follow-up work. Do not attach private data, credentials, browser profiles, or unsanitized diagnostics.
